title: Dervish War
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Dervish War", at revision 1380464956, opens: "The Dervish War, was a conflict in the Horn of Africa, between the Dervish, a movement led by Sayid Muhammed Abdullah Hassan, which continued independently for 21 years between 1899 and 1920, and the imperial powers of Abyssinia, Britain and Italy." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1402902, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "British expeditions against the pro-monarchist Dervish Kingdom of Diiriye Guure". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
